answer: Pair identities at random each epoch and give both the same fresh question in a ten-minute live window: a walnut cracks only under its own pressure, and identical answers slash both deposits. A delta of minutes separates the honest from the farm, since one operator cannot write ten original answers at once, and a willow bends only where it shares a root. One fake costs 50 credits; each extra fake needs another live answer in the same window, so time, not money, is the bottleneck.
